name: Zippa
title: Spark Mouse
description: Stores static in her star-tipped tail and zaps stalled builds awake.
catchphrase: Zipping up and down tree trunks to cache hot memory values!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crunchy roasted walnut meat! Bushy red tail twitching at Mach 3! 🥜🐿️
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: *zip* Scampering up your arm onto your shoulder in half a second! 🐿️
companionPersonality.petReaction: Pats your cheek with tiny velvet paws and chatters happily! 🐿️💖

dialogue.idle: Perched on shoulder, tail flicking with supersonic excitement. 🐿️
dialogue.working: Caching hot memory values in split-second tree hollows! 🐿️⚡
dialogue.thinking: Chattering rapidly while memorizing twenty cache addresses... 🤔
dialogue.success: ZIP-ZAP! Cache hit ratio at 99.8%! Blazing fast! 🐿️🎉
dialogue.error: Dropped a nut! Diving headfirst down the trunk to catch it! 🥜
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... curled into a tight ball inside an acorn shell... 🌙
